newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan opposition says it killed army officer.
newsitem.headline: Sudan opposition says it killed army officer.

text.p: A major Sudanese opposition group the Beja Congress said on Thursday it killed one Sudanese government army lieutenant and wounded two soldiers in an attack.

The Congress said in a statement issued in the Eritrean capital it attacked a National Islamic Front (NIF) vehicle near Karora close to the Sudanese border in retaliation for torture by government forces.
The NIF is said to control Sudanese military government in Khartoum.
The Beja Congress falls under the umbrella of the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), which is supported by Eritrea in its campaign against Sudan's NIF government.
